name: trialagents-pipeline
description: Track biotech programs, milestones, activities, decisions, deliverables, risks and changes in an interactive team workspace.

interface.longDescription: Track biotech programs, milestones, activities, decisions, deliverables, risks and changes in an interactive team workspace. Open the workspace in your assistant, check your team’s timeline and record changes. Editors can save filtered views. Workspace owners can adjust navigation and appearance. Individual use is free. Team access costs US$49 per workspace per month for unlimited seats, billed on the website.
defaultPrompt: Show my pipeline and the milestones due next.
Create a saved view of planned activities in my workspace.
Show the dependencies for my selected milestone.
